name: Region Editor
description: Regions (war3map.w3r) in the terrain editor: draw, move, resize, name, weather, ambient sound, colour.

mcpTools.name: add_region
mcpTools.description: Adds a region (rectangle in map coordinates; triggers call it gg_rct_<name>). Needs the setting mcp.writeTools; undo_last_edit takes it back.

mcpTools.name: remove_region
mcpTools.description: Removes a region. Triggers using it must be changed too. Needs the setting mcp.writeTools; undo_last_edit takes it back.

mcpTools.name: list_regions
mcpTools.description: The open map's regions: name, rectangle, weather, ambient sound. Triggers call them gg_rct_<name>.
